nom: NUXE Huile Prodigieuse Body Lotion, Satin Finish on the Skin, 6.7 Fl Oz

avis.titre: AMAZING SCENT, TOO STRONG I mixed w/ unscented lotionAMAZING SCENT, TOO STRONG I mixed w/ unscented lotion
avis.texte: The scent is amazing but extremely strong, like wearing too much perfume, but I love it so I bought an unscented lotion to mix it into. It also contains dimethicone which I looked up since it is one of the top ingredients. I searched Dimethicone and found that it is safe & frequently used in products & acts as a barrier but that it can also trap bacteria. I search ingredients because I have sensitive skin & members in my family have certain issues, i.e. one has psoriasis for example. So I have become more careful with any skin product since ingredients, even ones that are organic, vegan & naturally derived can have an adverse effect depending on what the issue may be. Of course any issue should be properly diagnosed by a professional. Still, some issues can be obvious and anyone should learn what ingredients in skincare products can help or not.

I loved the creamy texture, not crazy about the smell kind of like the way your grandma smelt…and my grandmother would be over hundred if she was alive. Thought it was a little pricey for the size and quality. Didn’t notice it working any better than a drug store brand.

Beautiful luxurious body lotion! I love the fragrance of this line. It’s reminiscent of old money-classy, elegant, soft & very feminine. Not to mention it softens my skin & gives it this healthy dewy glow. One of my favorite lines that makes me feel rich, like I’m getting a spa treatment each time I use it.

The scent is out of this world🌍!!! It has a wonderful serum like texture and very moisturizing💯💯. A comforting powdery scent 💞combined with a non greasy feel is so worth the money💲. I run out of it all the time. It is divine and it will not disappoint❣️. 😊👍
I discovered this brand in France and I am hooked. It has a fresh scent, makes my skin feel luxurious, and goes on without a greasy feel. I use it daily.

avis.titre: Such a great product! Glad to see it on Amazon
avis.texte: This is such a great product. Found it in a drugstore in Paris and was so happy to see it on Amazon! Absolutely love the scent! Get the foaming shower oil too! So good.
The lotion has a concentrate scent that dissipates after it dries a little on your skin so it’s just right; not too overpowering
This leaves your skin filling, silky, smooth, and it smells amazing. I got it while my daughter and I were traveling through Greece. So glad Amazon carries it.
Love this body lotion! Amazing smell and makes the skin feel soft and silky. Will be buying again.
Got it today, can't wait to start using it. Wondering why it didn't come sealed :/
